module: Route class on the navgraph (`map` module): computes a path through a list of positions, stores the remaining distances (distToTarget), tracks a vehicle, the camera or a position, shortens the path as progress is made and recalculates it when the target strays more than 18 m from it. Computations can run asynchronously in core_jobsystem (setupPathMultiJob, recalculateRoute). The module returns a constructor: `require('/lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/route/route')()`. Each path point is a table {pos, wp, linkCount, distToTarget, fixed}.
usage:
local route = require('/lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/route/route')()
route:setRouteParams(nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil)
route:setupPathMulti({vec3(0,0,0), vec3(500,200,0)})
local idx, dist = route:trackVehicle(be:getPlayerVehicle(0))
notes: A `fixed` point is a mandatory stage (arrival of each segment); recalculateRoute only recalculates up to the first fixed point, then reattaches the rest of the path (the "tail").
"On the path" distance: onPathDist = 18 m; points closer than 1 m (closeDistSquared = 1) are merged.
The lockFixedNodes field (uninitialized, to be set from outside) prevents going past a fixed point while tracking.
updatePathForPos does a print("recalculateRoute(pos)") when an ongoing recalculation is replaced because the vehicle strayed too far from the anchor.
The onRecalculatedRoute hook (no argument) is emitted at the end of an asynchronous recalculation. The equivalent raceRoute module emits the same hook with the argument 'raceRoute'.
The debugLog function is disabled (debugLog = nop): no debug log is emitted. Jobs use global_pathJobMaxDt or a near-zero dt (1e-11) to yield at each search step.

C.desc: Route. Fields: path, dirMult (1e3), distance, cutOffDrivability, penaltyAboveCutoff, penaltyBelowCutoff, wD, wZ, done, lastDist, lastIndexAtDist, lockFixedNodes.

init.desc: Constructor: empty path, dirMult = 1e3, no job running.

setRouteParams.desc: Sets the search parameters passed to map.getPointToPointPath / map.getPath.

stepAhead.desc: Returns the point located stepDist meters further along the route, storing the last position to speed up successive calls.

stepDist.desc: Distance to advance (m), accumulated with the previous one unless reset.

reset.desc: true to restart from the beginning.

returns.desc: {n1, n2, idx, pos, xnorm}; nil if the path has fewer than 2 points. At the end of the route, returns the last segment with xnorm = 1.

calcDistance.desc: Recalculates distToTarget of each point (remaining distance to the end) and self.distance.

setupPath.desc: Simple route between two positions (calls setupPathMulti).

setupPathMultiWaypoints.desc: Appends to the path the navgraph nodes between given waypoints (map.getPath), without consecutive duplicates, then computes the distances.

setupPathMulti.desc: Builds (synchronously) a path through all the positions. The arrival of each segment is a `fixed` point. Close points are merged and the endpoints are adjusted to the closest segment.

setupPathMultiJob.desc: Like setupPathMulti but the search runs in core_jobsystem (yields between steps). self.path is replaced once the computation finishes. Cancels any ongoing recalculation or previous job.

onComplete.desc: Called with the route at the end of the job.

clear.desc: Cancels ongoing jobs and clears the path.

getNextFixedWP.desc: Position of the first fixed point of the path.

unflagFirstFixedNode.desc: Removes the fixed flag from the first fixed point (stage reached).

returns.desc: true if a point was modified.

recalculateRoute.desc: Recalculates the route from startPos in an asynchronous task. If a fixed point exists, only redoes the section up to it then reattaches the rest; otherwise redoes the route up to the last point. Emits the onRecalculatedRoute hook at the end. Cancels previous jobs.

getPositionOffset.desc: Finds the path segment closest to a position.

returns.desc: Segment index if within 18 m, 0 otherwise.
Minimum distance to the path in meters.

shortenPath.desc: Removes the points before index idx (the first idx-1 points).

trackVehicle.desc: Tracks a vehicle (updatePathForPos on its position).

updatePathForPos.desc: Updates the route for a position: starts a recalculation if 18 m or more from every segment, cancels a recalculation that has become unnecessary, shortens the path and adjusts the first point to the position. Sets done = true if the path has fewer than 2 points.

returns.desc: Segment index (0 if off the path).
Distance to the path in meters.
